method: Single local before/after run per browser; 1-second paused window, 2.5-second 900x playback from 07:00, Europe then Britain. Canvas command instrumentation adds overhead. p95 is the app rolling draw statistic, not a frame-rate or isolated playback measurement. WebKit is a Mac browser with a phone viewport, not a physical phone.
